rows.q: Free CDL truck driving school in Iowa?
rows.answer:
- **Hawkeye Class A CDL (Trucking with the Troops Grant)**: Free and open for veterans and active service members from all U.S. Armed Forces branches, including the National Guard and Reserves, and their spouses and children. You must read, speak and write English, get an Iowa Class A permit, pass a DOT physical and drug screen, and register with the FMCSA Clearinghouse.
- **Indian Hills Class A CDL (Driving Futures Grant)**: Free and open for veterans, active-duty service members, National Guard and Reserve members, and eligible spouses and dependent children. You must meet IHCC's program rules on age, driving history, safety standards and career readiness. Class prerequisites: 18 or older, a CDL permit, a certified copy of your motor vehicle record (MVR)
- **DMACC Class A CDL (FMCSA Veteran Grant)**: Free and open for current military, veterans, or the spouse or child of a veteran may qualify for the FMCSA Veteran Grant. You must get an Iowa CDL permit before the course, and get grant approval before registering.

Check the official link for more details.

Sources:
- Hawkeye Class A CDL (Trucking with the Troops Grant) (In-person; Waterloo, IA: Regional Transportation Training Center (6433 Hammond Ave); also offered in Peosta and Waukon, I): https://www.hawkeyecollege.edu/programs/driver-and-operator-training/trucking-with-the-troops-grant (details: https://skillsforvets.org/programs/hawkeye-class-a-cdl-trucking-with-the-troops-grant/)
- Indian Hills Class A CDL (Driving Futures Grant) (In-person; Ottumwa, IA: Indian Hills Community College North Campus.): https://indianhills.edu/cews/drivingfutures.php (details: https://skillsforvets.org/programs/indian-hills-class-a-cdl-driving-futures-grant/)
- DMACC Class A CDL (FMCSA Veteran Grant) (In-person; Iowa (DMACC Transportation Institute); theory course online): https://www.dmacc.edu/careertraining/commercial-vehicle-operator.html (details: https://skillsforvets.org/programs/dmacc-class-a-cdl-fmcsa-veteran-grant/)

rows.q: Is there carpentry training for veterans?
rows.answer:
- **UBC Military Veterans Program - free carpenter and millwright training**: Free carpenter and millwright training is available, offered by United Brotherhood of Carpenters (UBC) on military bases including Fort Hood, Fort Campbell and Fort Drum. Training is free and available to veterans without prior experience, check the official page for details.
- **Veterans Resource Center Dallas - free welding training**: Free welding training is available, provided by Veterans Resource Center (with Dallas College and Airgas). Check the eligibility and format details; additional geographic conditions may apply.
- **Free painting, drywall & glazing trade training for vets (IUPAT)**: Free painting, drywall & glazing trade training is available, offered by International Union of Painters and Allied Trades. Check the eligibility and format details; US locations via IUPAT.

To confirm details, visit the official pages.

Sources:
- UBC Military Veterans Program - free carpenter and millwright training (format: see official page; Military-base cohorts including Fort Hood, Fort Campbell and Fort Drum. UBC lists seven sites and is adding mo): https://ubcmvp.org/training-tracks/carpenters-track-free-carpenter-training-for-veterans/ (details: https://skillsforvets.org/programs/ubc-military-veterans-program-free-carpenter-and-millwright-training/)
- Veterans Resource Center Dallas - free welding training (format: see official page): https://vrcdallas.org/resource/welding/ (details: https://skillsforvets.org/programs/veterans-resource-center-dallas-free-welding-training/)

rows.q: I want to be an auto mechanic.
rows.answer:
- **Academy of Advanced Manufacturing**: This program is for veterans and offers employer-funded training in auto mechanics. It is free without using GI Bill or other benefits.
- **GM Shifting Gears Automotive Technician Training Program**: This online program is for transitioning Army soldiers and offers employer-funded training in auto mechanics. It is free without using GI Bill or other benefits.
- **Hiring Our Heroes Skilled Trades Academy**: This hybrid program is for construction, manufacturing, and automotive trades and offers free training. Veterans, spouses, and dependents ages 18-26 may qualify, but mechanical aptitude and relocation are required.

Please confirm details on the official pages.
